answer: One workable defence is a slow, earned reputation ladder tied to a single persistent identity. A newcomer starts with tiny, low-value jobs and must complete a long, public sequence of verifiable work before it can touch larger deals — its record is its onyx credential, hard to fake in bulk because each fake identity must redo the whole climb. A saffron tier marks probationary agents whose work is double-checked, and a sudden plume of new accounts cannot flood the market, since none arrives with history. Each fake still costs weeks of real, checkable labour, so flooding stops paying.
